name: neeraj varma
player_statement:
A complete player, neeraj varma has made a big mark in cricket. With 111 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 69*, with an average of 11.36 and a quick strike rate of 161.20. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 76 sixes and 87 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 266.4 overs, taking 172 wickets at an economy rate of 9.38. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
